# normal instruction results.md

`ai-compiler -O0` normal RV64IMAFD path. Inputs, output and assembly are real compiler / `rvss` results.

## 1. ai.add  (N=4)

Input A: `-2.0 3.0 0.0 5.0`
Input B: `2.0 -4.0 6.0 0.0`
Output:  `0.0 -1.0 6.0 5.0`

Command (prints the operands + this result):
```bash
bash tests/unit/show.sh add4 sw
```

Assembly (`ai-compiler -O0`):
```asm
# Generated by ai-compiler from build/unit/add4.aiir (RV64IMAFD software lowering)
        .option norvc
        .text
        .align  2
        .globl  ai_kernel
ai_kernel:
        li      t0, 4                      # n
        mv      t1, a0
        mv      t2, a1
        addi    t3, sp, -16                 # dst %d
.Lsw1_2:
        flw     fa0, 0(t1)
        flw     fa1, 0(t2)
        fadd.s  fa2, fa0, fa1
        fsw     fa2, 0(t3)
        addi    t1, t1, 4
        addi    t2, t2, 4
        addi    t3, t3, 4
        addi    t0, t0, -1
        bnez    t0, .Lsw1_2
        addi    t1, sp, -16
        mv      t2, a2                      # OUT
        li      t0, 4
.Lret5:
        flw     fa0, 0(t1)
        fsw     fa0, 0(t2)
        addi    t1, t1, 4
        addi    t2, t2, 4
        addi    t0, t0, -1
        bnez    t0, .Lret5
        ret
        .size   ai_kernel, .-ai_kernel
```

## 7. ai.relu  (N=4 (unary))

Input A: `-2.0 3.0 0.0 5.0`
Input B: `n/a (unary)`
Output:  `0.0 3.0 0.0 5.0`

Command (prints the operands + this result):
```bash
bash tests/unit/show.sh relu4 sw
```

Assembly (`ai-compiler -O0`):
```asm
# Generated by ai-compiler from build/unit/relu4.aiir (RV64IMAFD software lowering)
        .option norvc
        .text
        .align  2
        .globl  ai_kernel
ai_kernel:
        li      t0, 4                      # n
        mv      t1, a0
        addi    t3, sp, -16                 # dst %d
.Lsw1_2:
        flw     fa0, 0(t1)
        fmv.w.x ft3, x0                    # 0.0f
        flt.s   t4, fa0, ft3               # a < 0 ?
        beq     t4, x0, 1f
        fmv.s   fa1, ft3
        j       2f
1:      fmv.s   fa1, fa0
2:      fsw     fa1, 0(t3)
        addi    t1, t1, 4
        addi    t3, t3, 4
        addi    t0, t0, -1
        bnez    t0, .Lsw1_2
        addi    t1, sp, -16
        mv      t2, a2                      # OUT
        li      t0, 4
.Lret5:
        flw     fa0, 0(t1)
        fsw     fa0, 0(t2)
        addi    t1, t1, 4
        addi    t2, t2, 4
        addi    t0, t0, -1
        bnez    t0, .Lret5
        ret
        .size   ai_kernel, .-ai_kernel
```

## 10. ai.matmul  (M=1 K=1 N=1)

Input A: `-2.0`
Input B: `2.0`
Output:  `-4.0`

Command (prints the operands + this result):
```bash
bash tests/unit/show.sh mm111 sw
```

Assembly (`ai-compiler -O0`):
```asm
# Generated by ai-compiler from build/unit/mm111.aiir (RV64IMAFD software lowering)
        .option norvc
        .text
        .align  2
        .globl  ai_kernel
ai_kernel:
        mv      a3, a0
        mv      a4, a1
        addi    a5, sp, -16                 # C %d
        li      t0, 1                      # M
        li      t1, 1                      # N
        li      t2, 1                      # K
        addi    a6, x0, 0                   # i
.Lmm_i1:
        bge     a6, t0, .Lmm_end1
        addi    a7, x0, 0                   # j
.Lmm_j1:
        bge     a7, t1, .Lmm_ni1
        fmv.w.x ft0, x0                     # acc = 0
        addi    t4, x0, 0                   # k
.Lmm_k1:
        bge     t4, t2, .Lmm_st1
        mul     t5, a6, t2
        add     t5, t5, t4
        slli    t5, t5, 2
        add     t5, a3, t5
        flw     fa0, 0(t5)
        mul     t5, t4, t1
        add     t5, t5, a7
        slli    t5, t5, 2
        add     t5, a4, t5
        flw     fa1, 0(t5)
        fmadd.s ft1, fa0, fa1, ft0
        fmv.s   ft0, ft1
        addi    t4, t4, 1
        j       .Lmm_k1
.Lmm_st1:
        mul     t5, a6, t1
        add     t5, t5, a7
        slli    t5, t5, 2
        add     t5, a5, t5
        fsw     ft0, 0(t5)
        addi    a7, a7, 1
        j       .Lmm_j1
.Lmm_ni1:
        addi    a6, a6, 1
        j       .Lmm_i1
.Lmm_end1:
        addi    t1, sp, -16
        mv      t2, a2                      # OUT
        li      t0, 16
.Lret5:
        flw     fa0, 0(t1)
        fsw     fa0, 0(t2)
        addi    t1, t1, 4
        addi    t2, t2, 4
        addi    t0, t0, -1
        bnez    t0, .Lret5
        ret
        .size   ai_kernel, .-ai_kernel
```
